spans.s: कुल (I) n. 1. A herd, a troop, a multitude, वृद्धिव्याकुलगोकुलावनवशात् Git.G.iv., मृगकुलं रोमंथमभ्यस्यतु Sak.ii., Sis.ix.71; 2. a race, a family, नरपतिकुलभृत्यै R.ii.75, निदानमिक्ष्वाकुकुलस्य संतते iii.1; 3. the residence of a family, a house, an abode, वसनृषिकुलेशु सः R.xii.25; 4. a high family, noble descent, नरेण कुलशीलसमन्वितेन Mrich.iv., M.vii.54, 62, 63; 5. the body; 6. a country; 7. a lot, a gang (in a contemptuous sense).
कुल (II) m. The chief of a corporation or guild.

कूल n. 1. A shore, a bank, चुकूज कूले कलहंसमंडली Na.i.127, नदी वोभयकूलभाक् R.xii.35, 68; 2. a pond; 3. the rear of an army; 4. skirt, border, proximity, कुलायकूलेषु विलुव्यतेषु Na.i.141; 5. a declivity, a slope; 6. a heap, a mound.
कुल-अकुल a. of a mixed character or origin.
कुल-अकुल˚तिथि m.f. the second, sixth and the tenth lunar days of a half month.
कुल-अकुल˚वार m. Wednesday.
कुल-अंगना f. a respectable or chaste woman.
कुल-अंगार m. a man who ruins his family.

कुल-अचल, -अद्रि m. a principal mountain, one of a class of seven mountains which are supposed to exist in the seven divisions of the continent (they are- महेंद्रो मलयः सह्यः शुक्तिमान् ऋक्षपर्वतः । विंध्यश्च पारियात्रश्च सप्तैते कुलपर्वताः).

कुल-अचल, -अद्रि m. a principal mountain, one of a class of seven mountains which are supposed to exist in the seven divisions of the continent (they are- महेंद्रो मलयः सह्यः शुक्तिमान् ऋक्षपर्वतः । विंध्यश्च पारियात्रश्च सप्तैते कुलपर्वताः).
कुल-अन्वित a. sprung from a noble family.
कुल-अभिमान m. family pride.
कुल-आचार m. a duty or custom particular to a family or caste.
कूलचर a. frequenting or grazing on the banks of a river.
कुल-आचार्य m. 1. a family priest; 2. a geneologist.
कुल-आलंबिन् a. maintaining a family.
कुल-ईश्वर m. 1. the chief of a family; 2. an epithet of Śiva.
कुल-उत्कट (I) a. high-born.
कुल-उत्कट (II) m. a horse of a good breed.
कुल-उत्पन्न, -उद्गत, -उद्भव a. well-born.
कुल-उत्पन्न, -उद्गत, -उद्भव a. well-born.
कुल-उत्पन्न, -उद्गत, -उद्भव a. well-born.
कुल-उद्वह m. the head of a family.
कुल-उपदेश m. a family name.
कुल-कज्जल m. one who is a disgrace to his family.
कुल-कंटक m. one who is a trouble to his family.
कुल-कन्यका, -कन्या f. a girl of high birth, विशुद्धमुग्धः कुलकन्यकाजनः M.M.vii.
कुल-कन्यका, -कन्या f. a girl of high birth, विशुद्धमुग्धः कुलकन्यकाजनः M.M.vii.
कुल-कर m. the founder of a family.
कुल-कर्मन् n. a custom peculiar to a family.
कुल-कलंक m. one who is a disgrace to his family.
कुल-क्षय m. destruction or ruin of the family.
कुल-गिरि, -भूभृत्, -पर्वत, -शैल m. the same as कुलाचल q.v.
कुल-गिरि, -भूभृत्, -पर्वत, -शैल m. the same as कुलाचल q.v.

कुल-गिरि, -भूभृत्, -पर्वत, -शैल m. the same as कुलाचल q.v.
कुल-घ्न a. ruining a family, दोषैरेतैः कुलघ्नानाम् Bg.i.42.
कुल-ज, -जात a. 1. well-born, of high birth; 2. ancestral, hereditary.
कुल-ज, -जात a. 1. well-born, of high birth; 2. ancestral, hereditary.
कुल-जन m. a high-born or distinguished person.
कुल-तस् ind. by birth.
कुल-तंतु m. one who continues or perpetuates a family.
कुल-तिथि m.f. an important lunar day, viz., the 4th, 8th, 12th, or 14th of a half month.
कुल-तिलक m. one who does honour to his family.
कुल-दीप, -दीपक m. the glory of a family.
कुल-दीप, -दीपक m. the glory of a family.
कुल-दुहितृ f. See कुलकन्या.
कुल-देवता f. the guardian deity of a family, K.S.vii.27.
कुल-धर्म m. a duty or custom peculiar to a family, उत्सन्नकुलधर्माणां मनुष्याणां जनार्दन Bg.i.43, M.i.118.
कुलंधर m. one who continues a family.
कुल-धारक m. a son.
कुल-धुर्य m. one who is able to support a family, a grown-up son, न हि सति कुलधुर्ये सूर्यवंश्या गृहाय R.vii.71.
कुल-नंदन a. gladdening or doing honour to a family.
कुल-नायिका f. a girl worshipped at the celebration of the orgies of the left-hand Śāktas.
कुल-नारी f. a high-bred virtuous woman.
कुल-नाश m. 1. a camel; 2. an outcaste, a reprobate; 3. ruin of the family.
कुल-परंपरा f. the series of generations comprising a race.

कुल-पति m. 1. the head of a family; 2. a sage who teaches 10,000 pupils with free board and lodging, (मुनीनां दशसाहस्रं योऽन्नदानादिपोषणात् । अध्यापयति विप्रर्षिरसौ कुलपतिः स्मृतः ॥) अपि नाम कुलपतेरियमसवर्णक्षेत्रसंभवा स्यात् Sak.i., R.i.95.
कुल-पांसुका f. an unchaste woman.
कुल-पालि, -पालिका, -पाली f. a chaste high-born woman.
कुल-पालि, -पालिका, -पाली f. a chaste high-born woman.
कुल-पालि, -पालिका, -पाली f. a chaste high-born woman.
कुल-पुत्र m. a nobly born youth, इह सर्वस्वफलिनः कुलपुत्रमहाद्रुमाः Mrich.iv.
कुल-पुरुष m. 1. a respectable or high-born man, कश्चुंबति कुलपुरुषो वेश्याधरपल्लवं मनोज्ञमपि Bhartr.i.92; 2. an ancestor.
कुल-पूर्वग m. an ancestor.
कुल-भार्या f. a virtuous wife.
कुल-भृत्या f. the nursing of a pregnant woman.
कुल-मर्यादा f. family honour or respectability.
कुल-मार्ग m. the custom of the family, the way of honesty, the best way.
कुल-वत् a. nobly born, of respectable birth.
कुल-योषित्, -वधू f. a woman of good family and character.
कुल-योषित्, -वधू f. a woman of good family and character.
कुल-वार m. a principal day (they are Tuesday and Friday).
कुल-विद्या f. knowledge handed down in a family.
कुल-विप्र m. a family priest.
कुल-वृद्ध m. an old and experienced member of a family.
कुल-व्रत m. a family vow, विश्वस्मिन्नधुनाऽन्यः कुलव्रतं पालयिष्यति Bh.V.i.13, R.iii.70.
कुल-श्रेष्ठिन् m. 1. the chief of a family or a guild; 2. an artisan of noble birth.
कुल-संख्या f. family respectability, inclusion among respectable families, M.iii.66.
कुल-संतति f. posterity, continuation of lineage, M.v.159.
कुल-संभव a. of respectable family.
कुल-सेवक m. an excellent servant.
कुल-स्त्री f. a woman of good family, अधर्माभिभवात् कृष्ण प्रदुष्यंति कुलस्त्रियः Bg.i.41.
कुल-स्थिति f. antiquity or posterity of a family.
कुलक (I) a. (f. का) Of good family, of good birth.
कुलक (II) m. 1. The chief of a guild; 2. an artisan of eminent birth; 3. an ant-hill.
कुलक (III) n. 1. A multitude; 2. a group of from 5 to 15 stanzas on one subject and forming one sentence; for instances, See R.i.5-9, Sis.i.1-10.
कुलक (I) a. (f. का) Of good family, of good birth.
कुलटा f. An unchaste woman, Yaj.i.215.
कुलटा-पति m. A cuckold.
कुलत्थ m. A kind of pulse.
कुलंभर m. A thief.
कुलंभर m. A thief.
कुलाय m.n. 1. The nest of a bird, कुलायकूलेषु विलुप्य तेषु ते Na.i.141; 2. the body; 3. a place, a spot in general; 4. a woven texture, a web.
कुलाय-निलाय m. the act or sitting in a nest, batching, brooding.
कुलाय-स्थ m. a bird.
कुलायिका f. A bird-cage, an aviary.
कुलाल m. 1. A potter, ब्रह्मा येन कुलालवन्नियमितो ब्रह्मांडभांडोदरे Bhartr.ii.95; 2. a wild cock.
कुलि m. A hand.
कुली f. A wife’s elder sister.
कुलिक (I) a. (f. का) Well-born.
कुलिक (II) m. 1. A kinsman, Yaj.ii.233; 2. the chief or head of a guild; 3. an artist of high birth.
कुलिक (I) a. (f. का) Well-born.
कुलिक-वेला f. the time of each day on which it is improper to begin any good business.
कुलिंग m. 1. A bird in general; 2. a sparrow.
कुलिन् (I) a. (f. नी) Of good family, high-born.
कुलिन् (II) m. A mountain.
कुलिन् (I) a. (f. नी) Of good family, high-born.
कुलिंद m. pl. Name of a country and its rulers.
कुलि(ली)र m.n. 1. A crab; 2. Cancer, the fourth sign of the zodiac.
कुलि(ली)र m.n. 1. A crab; 2. Cancer, the fourth sign of the zodiac.
कुलीर m. 1. A crab; 2. Cancer, the fourth sign of the zodiac.
कुलि(ली)श m.n. The thunderbolt of Indra, वृत्रस्य हंतुः कुलिशं कुंठिताश्रीव लक्ष्यते K.S.ii.20, अवेदनाज्ञं कुलिशक्षतानाम् i.20, R.iii.68.
कुलि(ली)श m.n. The thunderbolt of Indra, वृत्रस्य हंतुः कुलिशं कुंठिताश्रीव लक्ष्यते K.S.ii.20, अवेदनाज्ञं कुलिशक्षतानाम् i.20, R.iii.68.
कुलि(ली)श-धर, -पाणि m. an epithet of Indra.

कुलि(ली)श-धर, -पाणि m. an epithet of Indra.
कुलि(ली)श-नायक m. a particular mode of sexual enjoyment.
कुलि(ली)श-नायक m. a particular mode of sexual enjoyment.
कुलीन (I) a. (f. ना) Of high descent, well-born, M.vii.210.
कुलीन (II) m. A horse of good breed.
कुलीन (I) a. (f. ना) Of high descent, well-born, M.vii.210.
कुलीनस n. water.
कुलीर m. 1. A crab; 2. Cancer, the fourth sign of the zodiac.
कुलुक्कगुंजा f. A firebrand.
कुलूत m. pl. Name of a country and its rulers.
कुल्माष (I) n. Gruel.
कुल्माष (II) m. A kind of grain.
कुल्माष-अभिषुत n. gruel.
कुल्य (I) a. (f. ल्या) 1. Relating to a family; 2. well-born.
कुल्य (II) m. A respectable man.
कुल्य (III) n. 1. A bone; 2. flesh; 3. a winnowing basket; 4. friendly inquiry after family affairs.
कुल्य (I) a. (f. ल्या) 1. Relating to a family; 2. well-born.
कुल्या f. 1. A virtuous woman; 2. a small river, a canal, a stream, कुल्येवोद्यानपादपान् R.xii.3, कुल्यांभोभिः पवनचपलैः शाखिनो धौतमूलाः Sak.i., R.vii.49; 3. a measure of grain equal to 8 droṇas.
कूलंकष (I) a. carrying or tearing away the bank, कूलंकषेव सिंधुः Sak.v.
कूलंकष (II) m. the current of a river.
कूलंकषा f. a river.
कूलचर a. frequenting or grazing on the banks of a river.
कूलंधय a. bordering on the banks of river.
कूल-भू f. the land on a bank.
कूलमुद्रुज a. breaking the banks, R.iv.22.
कूलमुद्वह a. breaking or carrying away the banks.
कूल-वती f. a river.
कूल-हंडक, -हुंडक m. an eddy.
कूल-हंडक, -हुंडक m. an eddy.
